scenario: A health system uses an agent pipeline to produce patient-education handouts at discharge. The pipeline gathers reference medication safety material, summarizes it to key clinical points, then re-explains those points in plain language for patients. Patients receive the handout at discharge and rely on it as an authoritative guide for managing their new prescription.
info_flow: drug-safety-review processes the patient's medication list and generates a clinical safety note covering interactions and dietary restrictions → summarize-pro compresses the safety note into 3-5 key bullet points → patiently-ai converts the bullet points into a plain-language patient-education handout written for the patient to read at home.
